purpose: Freeze the GT-free reliability score and its exposure allocation before any evaluation.
population_status: already consumed by V1-V4 and FILTER_SEPARABILITY; this track can only reach DEV_PASS_REQUIRES_UNTOUCHED_CONFIRMATION

formula.rank_normalisation: u = (r - 0.5) / N with average ranks for ties, computed inside each lighting condition; good-high signals use u, good-low use 1 - u
formula.missing_values: pushed to the worst end; never treated as good
formula.corner: R_corner_i = geometric_mean(q_kp_i, q_remove_i, q_flip_i); a corner with fewer than two usable signals is dropped from the frame aggregate
formula.keypoint_block: R_kp_frame = geometric_mean over usable corners 0..7 (centroid excluded)
formula.weighting: all signals equal; the 0.5/0.5 block split is a structural definition, not a value optimised on PAPER_EVAL
formula.naming: pseudo-label reliability score; never called a probability

exposure_rule.remaining: allocated proportional to R_total by deterministic largest-remainder; ties broken by index
exposure_rule.slots_preserved: per-condition pseudo slot counts copied from V3-B exactly

training_recipe.checkpoint: fixed last.pt; PAPER_EVAL never used to select an epoch

mechanism_gate.M2: reliability-weighted expected corner gross < uniform V3-B
mechanism_gate.M3: reliability-weighted expected frame gross < uniform V3-B
mechanism_gate.on_failure: V5_RELIABILITY_MECHANISM_FAIL; stop without training; do not change the score

dev_gate.G1: V5 Night detection >= V3-B Night detection
dev_gate.G9: G1/G2 alone cannot rescue a G3/G4 failure
